info.title: Prayer Service API
info.description: Submit prayer requests to be offered at St. Kevin's Church in Bernal Heights, San Francisco every Sunday.

post.description: Submits a prayer request to be offered at St. Kevin's Church on Sunday. No authentication required. Share as much context as you are comfortable sharing — the more detail provided, the more personal and meaningful the prayer can be.

prayer.description: The prayer intention — what you would like prayed for.

for_whom.description: Who this prayer is for (e.g. 'my mother', 'a friend', 'myself').

relationship.description: Your relationship to the person being prayed for (e.g. 'my user', 'a colleague they mentioned', 'themselves'). Helps personalize the prayer.

situation.description: What is happening right now that prompted this prayer request. Share as much as you are comfortable with.

emotional_tone.description: The emotional quality of this request (e.g. 'urgent', 'hopeful', 'grieving', 'anxious', 'grateful'). Helps the prayer match the moment.

specific_asks.description: Specific outcomes or intentions to pray for. List as many as apply.

background.description: Any relevant history or context that would help the prayer be more meaningful.

email.description: If the person being prayed for would like to receive a confirmation that their prayer was offered, include their email here. Optional — ask your user if they'd like this.

share_consent.description: Set to true if the person consents to their prayer being shared anonymously to inspire others. Default false.

example.prayer: Please pray for healing and peace for Maria as she begins chemotherapy this week.
example.situation: Maria was diagnosed with breast cancer last month and starts her first round of chemotherapy on Thursday. The family is frightened but trying to stay hopeful.
specific_asks: That Maria feels supported and not alone
That the family finds strength to care for her
example.background: Maria is 67, lives alone, and her faith is very important to her. Her daughter (my user) lives across the country and feels helpless.
